title: Braised Moroccan Pork Knuckle
description: A rich, slow-cooked Moroccan dish that will fall off the bone. A perfect comfort food for a cold evening.
instructions: Season the pork knuckle with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork and set aside.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, honey, and lemon juice to the pot.
Return the pork knuckle to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the pork for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling off the bone.
